goal: I keep one project as brief, work and proof: its folders mount as the one profile whose workflow amy derives from them, a row walks from BRIEF through WORK and PROVE as child records, the proof is handed exactly the criteria the brief settled, and a refused proof carries the row back to WORK. A phase declared absent says at the status why it is out; a phase exporting no declared workflow is refused by its directory; a packaged workflow keeps the layout it always had and declares its phases; and the project's records, queue, tasks and threads live under one project state, with no path in the config and none of it outside Amy home.
